title: Arbitrary-Scale UAV Video Super-Resolution
description:
Against the backdrop of the booming low-altitude economy, drone aerial videos have become a core data source for fields such as land surveying and mapping, emergency rescue, and precision agriculture. However, constrained by payload power consumption and transmission bandwidth, raw videos often face bottlenecks like low resolution and blurred details, which restrict the effectiveness of downstream target recognition and scene analysis. As a key technology to break through hardware limitations and enhance data value, video super-resolution reconstruction serves as a crucial bridge connecting front-end data acquisition with back-end intelligent applications. To gather top-tier algorithm teams worldwide, explore the technological boundaries of spatiotemporal information mining, and tackle the challenges of detail recovery and texture enhancement in complex dynamic scenes, we are proud to host the Drone Video Super-Resolution Reconstruction Competition.

Through this competition, we aim to stimulate algorithmic innovation and improve system capabilities in high-fidelity temporal reconstruction and fine texture recovery under real-world aerial scenarios characterized by low resolution, high compression, and motion blur. This event will not only serve as a comprehensive assessment of technical strength at the intersection of computer vision and temporal signal processing but also provide forward-looking exploration for major applications such as all-weather intelligent surveillance, high-precision geographic information updating, and automated disaster assessment.
description_zh:
在低空经济蓬勃发展的大背景下，无人机航拍视频已成为国土测绘、应急救援、精准农业等领域的核心数据源。然而，受限于载荷功耗和传输带宽的制约，原始视频常面临分辨率低、细节模糊等瓶颈问题，这严重影响了下游目标识别和场景分析的有效性。视频超分辨率重建作为突破硬件限制、增强数据价值的关键技术，是连接前端数据采集与后端智能应用的重要桥梁。为汇聚全球顶尖算法团队，探索时空信息挖掘的技术边界，攻克复杂动态场景中的细节恢复和纹理增强难题，我们荣幸举办无人机视频超分辨率重建竞赛。

通过此次竞赛，我们旨在激发算法创新，提升真实无人机航拍场景中的高保真时间重建和精细纹理恢复能力——这些场景往往具有低分辨率、高压缩率和运动模糊的特点。该赛事不仅是对计算机视觉与时间信号处理交叉领域技术实力的全面考察，也为全天候智能监控、高精度地理信息更新和自动灾情评估等重大应用提供前瞻性探索。

pages.content:
### 🏆 1. Competition Overview

- **Competition Name:** CSIG Image and Graphics Technology Challenge - UAV Video Arbitrary Scale Super-Resolution Reconstruction Challenge
- **Organizer:** China Society of Image and Graphics (CSIG)
- **Co-organizers:** Sun Yat-sen University, Information Engineering University
- **Background:** Addressing the application requirements of UAV aerial video in national land surveying, emergency rescue, and other fields under the low-altitude economy, this challenge aims to solve the problems of low resolution and blurred details caused by hardware limitations. It seeks to enhance video super-resolution reconstruction capabilities through algorithmic innovation.

### 📅 2. Participation Requirements & Schedule

- **Eligibility:** Open to enterprises, institutions, faculty, students, and teams (maximum of 5 members per team) from across the country, as well as individuals.
- Key Dates:
  - **Registration Period:** June 3, 2026 – August 15, 026
  - **Submission Period:** June 20, 2026 – August 20, 2026
- Platforms:
  - Competition Website: `[Codabench](https://www.codabench.org/competitions/edit/17147/)` 
  - Registration Link: [](https://v.wjx.cn/vm/OIAIWZk.aspx#)

### 📹 3. Competition Data & Task

- Dataset Composition:
  - **Evaluation Set:** Includes 2 sets of UAV visible-light video datasets (covering scenarios like weak-texture roads and drastic viewpoint changes) and 1 set of UAV thermal-infrared video dataset (covering scenarios like edge blurring and low SNR).
  - **Task Objective:** Input is low-resolution UAV video sequences. Output must support high-resolution reconstruction at arbitrary scales (4x, 6.7x, 9.8x, 12.9x).
  - **Ground Truth:** High-resolution ground truth is provided for quantitative evaluation. Participants may select their own training data.
- Submission Requirements:
  - Reconstruction results (High-resolution videos).
  - Code and documentation (Run scripts/Source code, Technical report ≤ 3 pages).

### 📊 4. Evaluation Criteria & Hardware Constraints

- Hardware Limits:
  - **CPU:** Xeon Platinum 8462Y+ / AMD Epyc 9534
  - **GPU:** NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell / A100
  - **Memory:** 128GB DDR4
- Core Evaluation Metrics (Threshold Conditions):
  - **Pixel Accuracy:** PSNR (Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio), SSIM (Structural Similarity Index).
  - **Perceptual Accuracy:** LPIPS (Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity), DISTS (Deep Image Structure and Texture Similarity).
  - **Temporal Accuracy:** tLP (Temporal Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity), tOF (Temporal Order Fidelity, estimated based on RAFT-Large optical flow).

| Scenario                               | Pixel Accuracy (PSNR/SSIM) | Perceptual Accuracy (LPIPS/DISTS) | Temporal Accuracy (tLP/tOF) |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------------- | --------------------------- |
| **General Requirement**                | PSNR≥28.0dB; SSIM≥0.750    | LPIPS≤0.250; DISTS≤0.180          | tLP≤12.00; tOF≤0.650        |
| **Visible Light Dataset**              | PSNR≥24.5dB; SSIM≥0.720    | LPIPS≤0.200; DISTS≤0.150          | tLP≤10.00; tOF≤0.600        |
| **Thermal Infrared Dataset**           | PSNR≥41.0dB; SSIM≥0.970    | LPIPS≤0.070; DISTS≤0.080          | tLP≤5.50; tOF≤7.50          |
| **Low-Light Night Scene (Additional)** | PSNR≥22.0dB; SSIM≥0.650    | LPIPS≤0.280; DISTS≤0.200          | tLP≤15.0; tOF≤0.800         |

### 📮 5. Contacts

- **Wang Hanyun** (Sun Yat-sen University): [wanghanyun@mail.sysu.edu.cn](mailto:wanghanyun@mail.sysu.edu.cn)
- **Dai Chenguang** (Information Engineering University): [cgdai2008@163.com](mailto:cgdai2008@163.com)
- **Li Wenke** (PhD Student, Sun Yat-sen University): [ieulwk@163.com](mailto:ieulwk@163.com)
- **Li Kangrui** (PhD Student, Information Engineering University): [kangrui.li21@outlook.com](mailto:kangrui.li21@outlook.com)

This competition closely aligns with the demands of the low-altitude economy, focusing on super-resolution reconstruction difficulties in complex UAV video scenarios. By setting strict metrics for pixel accuracy, perception, and temporal consistency, it aims to promote the practical application of computer vision technology in real-world aerial footage.

pages.title: Evaluation
pages.content:
### Weight Allocation Strategy

This scheme significantly increases the weight of perceptual metrics, establishing LPIPS and DISTS as core indicators; uses pixel metrics as constraints for basic fidelity; and employs temporal metrics to guarantee a baseline for video quality.

| Metric Category | Role | Specific Metric | Weight ($W$) | Design Rationale |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Perceptual Quality** | Core Dominant | **LPIPS** | **30%** | Primary metric. The most human-perception-aligned metric in deep learning super-resolution. High weight encourages models to generate rich high-frequency textures and avoid over-smoothing. |
| | Detail Auxiliary | DISTS | 20% | Secondary metric. Combines structural and textural distortion, specifically validating details of complex ground objects (e.g., trees, roofs) from a drone perspective to prevent artifacts. |
| **Pixel Accuracy** | Basic Constraint | PSNR | 15% | Primary metric. Although its weight is reduced, it remains the physical baseline to prevent severe color shifts or noise amplification caused by pursuing perceptual quality. |
| | Structural Auxiliary | SSIM | 10% | Secondary metric. Ensures overall structural integrity, guaranteeing clear building outlines without structural collapse. |
| **Temporal Consistency** | Stability Guarantee | tLP | 15% | Primary metric. Measures temporal jitter in feature space. Flickering is fatal for video tasks; sufficient weight is required to ensure viewing comfort. |
| | Motion Validation | tOF | 10% | Secondary metric. Constrains motion consistency at the physical optical flow level to prevent non-physical jumps in object trajectories. |
| **Total** | - | - | **100%** | - |

### Detailed Calculation Formulas

To fairly compare metrics with different dimensions, **Min-Max Normalization** is applied to map all metrics to the $[0, 1]$ interval before weighted summation.

#### Step 1: Data Collection & Extreme Value Determination
Let the set of participating teams be $N$. For each metric $m$ (e.g., PSNR, LPIPS):
- Identify the maximum value $Max_m$ and minimum value $Min_m$ across all teams.
- *Note: To prevent extreme outliers from skewing normalization, it is recommended to exclude the top 1% and bottom 1% extreme values before determining Max/Min, or set theoretical upper/lower bounds (e.g., capping PSNR at 40dB).*

#### Step 2: Metric Normalization
Since metric directions differ (higher is better vs. lower is better), they must be processed separately:

**A. Positive Metrics (Higher is Better):** PSNR, SSIM
$$ Score_{i,m} = \frac{Value_{i,m} - Min_m}{Max_m - Min_m} $$

**B. Negative Metrics (Lower is Better):** LPIPS, DISTS, tLP, tOF
$$ Score_{i,m} = \frac{Max_m - Value_{i,m}}{Max_m - Min_m} $$

*Where $Score_{i,m}$ represents the normalized score of team $i$ on metric $m$ (ranging from 0 to 1).*

#### Step 3: Weighted Total Score Calculation
$$ TotalScore_i = (0.30 \times S_{LPIPS}) + (0.20 \times S_{DISTS}) + (0.15 \times S_{PSNR}) + (0.10 \times S_{SSIM}) + (0.15 \times S_{tLP}) + (0.10 \times S_{tOF}) $$

The final score should be rounded to four decimal places.

### Threshold Condition Review (Based on New Strategy)

To align with the new weighting system, it is recommended to update entry thresholds simultaneously. This ensures that top-scoring teams excel not only in perception but also meet baseline quality standards:

| Dimension | Metric | Recommended Threshold | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Perceptual** | LPIPS | $\le 0.250$ | Core threshold. Values above this indicate insufficient texture recovery capability. |
| **Perceptual** | DISTS | $\le 0.180$ | Auxiliary threshold. Prevents structural collapse caused by over-optimizing for LPIPS. |
| **Pixel** | PSNR | $\ge 26.0 \text{ dB}$ | Appropriately relaxed (compared to pure PSNR orientation). Allows sacrificing a small amount of SNR for perceptual quality, but not excessively. |
| **Pixel** | SSIM | $\ge 0.700$ | Ensures basic structural similarity. |
| **Temporal** | tLP | $\le 12.0$ | Baseline requirement to ensure flicker-free video. |
| **Temporal** | tOF | $\le 0.650$ | Ensures generally reasonable motion trajectories. |
pages.content_zh:
### 权重分配策略

该方案大幅提升感知度量权重，将LPIPS和DISTS确立为核心指标；采用像素度量作为基本保真度的约束；并使用时间度量保证视频质量的基线。

| 度量类别 | 角色 | 具体度量 | 权重（$W$） | 设计原理 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **感知质量** | 核心主导 | **LPIPS** | **30%** | 主要度量。深度学习超分辨率中与人类感知对齐度最高的度量。高权重鼓励模型生成丰富的高频纹理并避免过度平滑。 |
| | 细节辅助 | DISTS | 20% | 次要度量。结合结构和纹理失真，特别从无人机视角验证复杂地物（如树木、屋顶）的细节，防止伪影。 |
| **像素准度** | 基本约束 | PSNR | 15% | 主要度量。虽然权重降低，但仍保持物理基线作用，防止因追求感知质量而产生的严重色移或噪声放大。 |
| | 结构辅助 | SSIM | 10% | 次要度量。确保整体结构完整性，保证建筑轮廓清晰且无结构坍塌。 |
| **时间一致性** | 稳定性保证 | tLP | 15% | 主要度量。测量特征空间中的时间抖动。闪烁对视频任务是致命的；需要充分权重保证观看舒适度。 |
| | 运动验证 | tOF | 10% | 次要度量。在物理光流层面约束运动一致性，防止物体轨迹出现非物理跳跃。 |
| **总计** | - | - | **100%** | - |

### 详细计算公式

为公平比较不同量纲的度量，采用**最小-最大归一化**将所有度量映射到$[0, 1]$区间，然后进行加权求和。

#### 第1步：数据收集与极值确定
设参赛团队集合为$N$。对于每个度量$m$（如PSNR、LPIPS）：
- 识别所有团队中的最大值$Max_m$和最小值$Min_m$。
- *注：为防止极端异常值扭曲归一化，建议在确定Max/Min前排除前1%和后1%的极端值，或设定理论上下界（如将PSNR上限设为40dB）。*

#### 第2步：度量归一化
由于度量方向不同（越高越好与越低越好），必须分别处理：

**A. 正向度量（越高越好）：** PSNR、SSIM
$$ Score_{i,m} = \frac{Value_{i,m} - Min_m}{Max_m - Min_m} $$

**B. 负向度量（越低越好）：** LPIPS、DISTS、tLP、tOF
$$ Score_{i,m} = \frac{Max_m - Value_{i,m}}{Max_m - Min_m} $$

*其中$Score_{i,m}$表示团队$i$在度量$m$上的归一化分数（范围0到1）。*

#### 第3步：加权总分计算
$$ TotalScore_i = (0.30 \times S_{LPIPS}) + (0.20 \times S_{DISTS}) + (0.15 \times S_{PSNR}) + (0.10 \times S_{SSIM}) + (0.15 \times S_{tLP}) + (0.10 \times S_{tOF}) $$

最终分数应四舍五入至四位小数。

### 阈值条件审核（基于新策略）

为与新的加权系统对齐，建议同步更新参赛阈值。这确保高分团队不仅在感知上表现出色，还符合基本质量标准：

| 维度 | 度量 | 推荐阈值 | 说明 |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **感知** | LPIPS | $\le 0.250$ | 核心阈值。超过此值表示纹理恢复能力不足。 |
| **感知** | DISTS | $\le 0.180$ | 辅助阈值。防止过度优化LPIPS导致的结构坍塌。 |
| **像素** | PSNR | $\ge 26.0 \text{ dB}$ | 适度放松（相比纯PSNR导向）。允许为感知质量牺牲少量SNR，但不可过度。 |
| **像素** | SSIM | $\ge 0.700$ | 确保基本结构相似度 |

pages.content:
### 📅 Competition Timeline
The competition is currently in the **Registration Phase**. According to the schedule outlined in the document, the key dates are as follows:

| Phase | Time Period | Status (as of Jun 16, 2026) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Registration** | June 3, 2026 - **August 15, 2026** | **Open** |
| **Result Submission** | June 20, 2026 - August 20, 2026 | Upcoming |

### 🎯 Eligibility and Entry
- **Open To:** Teams and individuals from enterprises, institutions, universities, and colleges nationwide.
- **Team Size:** Each team must consist of **no more than five (5) members**.

### 💻 Technical Specifications
To ensure fairness and practical applicability, the competition enforces strict hardware and output constraints.

#### 1. Hardware Constraints
All solutions must be executable on hardware not exceeding the following specifications:
- **CPU:** Xeon Platinum 8462Y+ / AMD Epyc 9534
- **GPU:** NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell / A100
- **Memory:** 128GB DDR4

#### 2. Submission Requirements
Participants must submit the following items:
- **Reconstruction Results:** High-resolution video outputs.
- **Code and Documentation:**
    - Executable scripts, programs, or source code.
    - A technical report (maximum 3 pages) including a method overview, innovations, runtime, and memory/GPU memory usage.

### 📊 Evaluation Criteria
The evaluation employs a multi-dimensional metric system to assess image quality, perception, and temporal consistency. The **threshold conditions** for qualifying submissions are detailed below.

#### Threshold Conditions for Qualification
Submissions must meet the following requirements across different scenarios to be considered valid.

| Scenario | Pixel Accuracy Requirements | Perceptual Accuracy Requirements | Temporal Consistency Requirements |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **General Requirements** | • PSNR ≥ 28.0dB• SSIM ≥ 0.750 | • LPIPS ≤ 0.250• DISTS ≤ 0.180 | • tLP ≤ 12.00• tOF ≤ 0.650 |
| **Visible Light Dataset** | • PSNR ≥ 24.5dB• SSIM ≥ 0.720 | • LPIPS ≤ 0.200• DISTS ≤ 0.150 | • tLP ≤ 10.00• tOF ≤ 0.600 |
| **Thermal Infrared Dataset** | • PSNR ≥ 41.0dB• SSIM ≥ 0.970 | • LPIPS ≤ 0.070• DISTS ≤ 0.080 | • tLP ≤ 5.50• tOF ≤ 7.50 |
| **Low-Light Night Scene*(Optional)* | • PSNR ≥ 22.0dB• SSIM ≥ 0.650 | • LPIPS ≤ 0.280• DISTS ≤ 0.200 | • tLP ≤ 15.0• tOF ≤ 0.800 |

> **Note:** The Low-Light Night Scene is an **optional additional item** and is not part of the mandatory qualification threshold.

### 📥 Registration and Access
- **Registration Link:** [https://v.wjx.cn/vm/OIAIWZk.aspx#](https://v.wjx.cn/vm/OIAIWZk.aspx#)

### 💻 技术规格

评估采用多维度指标体系来评估图像质量、感知质量和时间一致性。**通过资格的阈值条件**详见下表。

#### 通过资格的阈值条件
提交的成果必须满足以下要求，在不同场景中才能被视为有效。
